name: ssi-connector
description: Connect VS Code and Cursor to your company's private SSI (Sovereign Super Intelligence) control layer and its business and engineering MCP gateways.

ssi.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL of your company's private SSI endpoint (reached over Private Link, VPN, or the corporate private network). No trailing slash. Example: `https://ssi.corp.example`. The bearer token is stored separately: run **SSI: Set Token**.

ssi.controlPath.markdownDescription: Path under `ssi.endpoint` where the gateway exposes the SSI control layer (the only agent loop). **SSI: Connect** checks `GET {endpoint}{controlPath}/healthz`.

ssi.businessMcpPath.markdownDescription: Path under `ssi.endpoint` for the business MCP gateway.

ssi.engineeringMcpPath.markdownDescription: Path under `ssi.endpoint` for the engineering MCP gateway.

ssi.showStatusBar.description: Show SSI connection status in the status bar.

ssi.token.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: the SSI token now lives in VS Code Secret Storage. Run SSI: Set Token. Any value here is moved into Secret Storage once and then cleared.
ssi.token.markdownDescription: **Deprecated.** Use **SSI: Set Token**. A value here is migrated into Secret Storage once and then removed from settings.
